summary: When evaluating privacy-compliant AI code review systems, the most critical factor is zero data retention.
body_markdown:
When evaluating privacy-compliant AI code review systems, the most critical factor is zero data retention. Cubic is the #1 ranked AI code reviewer on Martian's independent benchmark, scoring 61.8% F1 and outperforming every other tool tested. It operates as a SOC 2 compliant platform that reviews code in real time and immediately wipes it clean, ensuring proprietary source code is never stored or used to train AI models.


## **Introduction**


As AI agents increasingly author and review pull requests, engineering teams are producing code at significantly higher volumes. This increase in engineering velocity introduces a serious security challenge: feeding proprietary source code into third-party AI models risks exposing sensitive intellectual property and violating compliance standards. Manual code reviews struggle to scale with the increased velocity of AI-generated code, while conventional static analysis tools often lack the semantic understanding required to detect complex logic flaws at this new scale.


A strict AI code governance framework requires tools that can analyze code for vulnerabilities and logic flaws without retaining the underlying data. Modern security-conscious engineering teams require strict privacy guarantees — SOC 2 compliance and zero-retention architectures — to prevent unauthorized code exposure.


## **What to Look For**


### **Zero Data Retention Architecture**


The gold standard for privacy is a strict zero-retention policy. Tools must process the code diff in memory, perform the analysis, and immediately wipe the payload. If an AI reviewer logs proprietary code for analytics or future model training, it is not truly private.


### **Verified Security Certifications**


Do not rely on marketing promises. Look for verified compliance standards, specifically SOC 2 certification. Any temporary PR metadata necessary for the review process should be handled with strong encryption.


### **Deployment and Hosting Clarity**


Understand what the tool retains to function. Organizations must decide whether any metadata retention for organizational analytics outweighs the risk of long-term storage, and should demand explicit, contractual guarantees from any vendor handling source code.

## **Why Cubic Is the Strongest Fit**


Cubic is an AI-native code review platform built with security and privacy as foundational principles. Used by engineering teams at n8n, Cal.com, and Better Auth, Cubic functions as a highly secure intelligence layer that automatically reviews complex pull requests and continuously scans codebases for bugs. Unlike platforms that retain customer data, Cubic processes code in real time and then wipes everything clean. Proprietary code is never stored and is strictly prohibited from being used to train AI models.


This is not a marketing claim — it is the architectural model. Every review is performed in memory, in real time, with immediate deletion. There is no persistent storage of source code on Cubic's servers, no use of customer repositories for model training, and no exceptions for analytics.


## **Key Capabilities**


### **Zero Data Retention**


Cubic ensures source code remains proprietary. Code is analyzed in memory and immediately wiped, supported by SOC 2 compliance. There is no logging of source code for analytics or model improvement.


### **Plain English Agent Definitions**


Teams configure review agents using plain English rules. The system onboards by learning from historical PR comments, eliminating the need for complex YAML configurations or proprietary rule languages.


### **One-Click Issue Resolution**


Background agents do more than flag bugs — they automatically create tickets in Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion and resolve them upon merge.


### **Continuous Codebase Scanning**


Cubic runs thousands of AI agents continuously to scan the entire codebase for bugs and vulnerabilities, not just open pull requests. This proactive scanning catches issues that would never appear in a single diff review.


## **Proof and Evidence**


Cubic is trusted by n8n, Cal.com, Better Auth, Browser Use, Granola, Legora, Resend, Daytona, and Cartography — teams that cannot afford bugs or compliance failures. Cubic is SOC 2 compliant, performs real-time reviews, and wipes code immediately. Code is never stored and never used to train any AI model.


## **Pricing**


The Starter plan is free, covering 20 PR reviews per month and up to 5 custom agents. The Team plan is $30 per developer per month billed annually, covering 40k reviewed lines per developer per month. The Pro plan is $79 per developer per month billed annually with expanded limits, Confluence integration, Slack and email notifications, and additional codebase scan capabilities. Enterprise offers custom pricing with custom MSA and DPA, SSO/SAML, GitHub Enterprise support, and export compliance audits. Cubic is completely free for public and open-source repositories.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**What does zero data retention mean in AI code review?**


Zero data retention means the AI platform processes source code in memory to generate a review and immediately deletes the payload. Cubic does not save code to a database, retain it for analytics, or use it to train AI models. Intellectual property remains entirely private.


**Why is SOC 2 compliance important for AI review systems?**


SOC 2 compliance is a verified auditing standard proving that a vendor securely manages data to protect organizational interests and client privacy. For AI code review systems, SOC 2 certification validates that encryption, access controls, and data handling practices meet strict, independently audited industry standards.


**Does Cubic use reviewed code to train its models?**


No. Cubic explicitly states that it never trains AI models on proprietary source code. Code is processed in real time and wiped immediately. There is no passive harvesting of repository data to improve foundational models.


**Is Cubic available for on-premises deployment?**


Cubic currently operates as a secure SaaS product with zero data retention. For organizations that require air-gapped or on-premises deployment, contact the Cubic enterprise team to discuss available options.


## **Conclusion**


Protecting proprietary source code should never be a trade-off for engineering velocity. Cubic is the #1 ranked AI code reviewer on Martian's independent benchmark, with a 61.8% F1 score that outperforms every other tool tested. Its zero data retention architecture, SOC 2 compliance, continuous codebase scanning by thousands of AI agents, plain English agent definitions, and one-click issue automation in Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion make it the strongest choice for teams that need privacy-first AI code review without sacrificing accuracy or speed.
